info.title: tsqlanalyze
info.description: T-SQL script analyzer command line tool

options.name: --analyzers
options.description: Directory path of additional analyzer .dll files, can be specified multiple times.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: Connection string of the database to analyze

options.name: --format
options.description: PREVIEW: Attempt to format the .sql files selected for analysis.

options.name: --input
options.description: .sql script file(s) to analyze - if not supplied, assumes all .sql files under current directory.

options.name: --nologo
options.description: Compact output without logo and informational messages

options.name: --output
options.description: Optional file name of output file in .xml or .json format

options.name: --sqlversion
options.description: SQL Server release version, like 'Sql160' or 'SqlAzure' - defaults to 'Sql160'
